name: The throne's splintered crown
summary: Fragments of the Frozen Throne become part of the next forging. The scattered splinters are gathered through Icecrown Citadel and carried back to Darion, who says their old power can be sealed into Shadow's Edge. The repeated shard tally belongs to the long work of the raid, not a second plot. What matters to the story is that the axe is being finished with fragments of the Lich King's own seat.
